question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH customer_period_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'January–June 2025'
      ELSE 'July–December 2025'
    END AS reporting_period,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    AND CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT reporting_period, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM customer_period_orders
WHERE order_count >= 2
GROUP BY reporting_period
ORDER BY reporting_period
action.metrics: Distinct customers with at least two recorded orders within the same half-year period

action.answer: Repeat customers are customers with at least two recorded orders within the same reporting half. January–June 2025: 95,048 repeat customers. July–December 2025: 96,514 repeat customers. July–December had more, by 1,466 customers.

final_answer: Repeat customers are customers with at least two recorded orders within the same reporting half. January–June 2025: 95,048 repeat customers. July–December 2025: 96,514 repeat customers. July–December had more, by 1,466 customers.
